notes.title: Steam Deck & Controller Update! The Operator 2.0 (5090)
notes.content:
Great news, Operators! [b][i]The Operator[/i][/b], fresh on the back of our Pégases award, now fully supports the Steam Deck! That means you can dive into the game wherever you go, with full controller support and optimized performance on Valve’s handheld device. [b]To check the version, look at the second number on the top right of the main menu. If it contains 5090 or greater, you're good![/b]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] ADD: Full controller support.
[*] ADD: SteamDeck support.
[*] ADD: UI scale option (100% - 120%).
[*] ADD: Proper audio description in cinematic (if the option is enabled).
[*] MOD: Improved graphics & color representation.
[*] MOD: Performance improvements.
[*] MOD: Region detection is working differently. This impacts the unit system, the date and time format. If the default values are not correct for you, please tell us.
[*] FIX: You can no longer win AND lose in the [spoiler]Lab if you wait for the end of the timer and defuse the bomb at the same time.[/spoiler]
[*] FIX: [spoiler]PENDELL status in HumanDB before and after the Lab.[/spoiler]
[*] FIX: Typos in Chinese.
[*] FIX: Incorrect font was used in non-english language in the Screen selector.
[*] FIX: Turkish systems no longer break the UI.
[*] FIX: Multiples small UI issues.
[*] FIX: Multiples bug fixes.
[/list]

If you have any issues, please join the discord server and report them!
